metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting invisible bugs and got 2 kills? Valorant, are you broken again?
metadata.description:
Me: wildly spamming clicks with zero aim
Enemies: probably uninstalling mid-death
Valorant said ‘Here’s 2 kills, good luck explaining that!’
Click if your chaos clicks ever surprise you!

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
